analysis_source: Onboarding 2026-10-09: local clone on branch EL-5353 (HEAD b961512), one commit ahead of main 6e4d67e. Refresh 2026-10-15: origin/main is 542997c, the merge of that PR (#367); the tree equals b961512 (empty git diff), so no knowledge changed. Read-only git only.
placement_reason: Role, callers, delivery, data ownership, capabilities, rules and exclusions were confirmed by the developer on 2026-10-09. The inbound transport service and the creation-event trigger are not named (unknown).

phases.I: complete (spot-checked only; no scan of PHI/secret logging across all account handlers, no dependency audit)
phases.L: complete (spot-checked in code: five EVENT_TYPE_MAPPER keys, find_best_match best_score * 100 comparison, mongoengine never imported, BILLING_LAMBDA_ARN loaded but unused, OIDC token written before zip -r, S3 prefixes orus/ dfts/ ehr_orus/, NEW_PATIENT_TASK_DESCRIPTION, acks and adts_book_keeping collection constants)
phases.M: complete (M1-M4 recorded; M5 verification in the final report)

unknowns: Lambda runtime version, handler string, memory, timeout, IAM role, VPC, layers, and how requirements.txt reaches the deployed function (pipeline has no pip step)
Identity of the inbound EMR transport service that supplies raw ADT/ACK/ORU text, and how EMRs reach it
Identity of the trigger fed by the rest-api-evoke hl7job SNS topic that invokes the creation events (developer confirmed it exists; it is not client-ehr-hl7-export)
Whether client-ehr-hl7-export is the real repository name of the delivery service (developer selected it; its repository name is unconfirmed)
Schema owner and indexes of the shared collections; developer confirmed ownership of adts, adts_book_keeping and acks only
Whether src/accountHandler/pueblo/, src/accountHandler/uch/ and pdf/utils.py are used (inferred dead from grep)
Contents of .env-example and .vscode/launch-example.json (read denied or not read)
Bitbucket branch restrictions and required builds for main
Per-account HL7 segment mappings (not analysed in depth)
Product-language definitions of ADT, ORU, DFT, IDCO ORU and ACK (recorded as inferred, standard HL7 meanings)
